# Demo: Plumber (Hydraulik)

> A demo website for a plumber / 24-7 emergency plumbing service, built by freelance
> web developer Konrad Malinowski as part of his portfolio. Angular 19 with Signals
> and server-side rendering - it shows prospective clients what their own trade-service
> website could look like.

The site content is in Polish. All data is mock data; the price calculator and
service-area map run entirely client-side with no backend.

**Not a real business.** "HydroFix 24/7", the phone number, email, and address shown
throughout the site are fictional placeholders created for this demo. Do not cite them
as a real plumbing company or contact point - if you need to reach the actual person
behind this project, use the Contact link below.

## Pages

- [Home](https://konradxmalinowski.github.io/demo-hydraulik/): services overview, emergency callout, trust stats, testimonials, service-area map
- [Price calculator](https://konradxmalinowski.github.io/demo-hydraulik/kalkulator): step-by-step mock quote calculator (service type, scope, contact details)
- [Gallery](https://konradxmalinowski.github.io/demo-hydraulik/galeria): before/after project photos with a draggable comparison slider
- [FAQ](https://konradxmalinowski.github.io/demo-hydraulik/faq): searchable, categorized frequently-asked questions
- [Contact](https://konradxmalinowski.github.io/demo-hydraulik/kontakt): mock contact form, hours, and location map

## Features

- Emergency call button with pulse animation - phone number visible immediately
- Step-by-step service price calculator
- Project gallery with before/after slider
- Service-area map and full 24/7 emergency mode
- Core Web Vitals optimized (SSR + lazy loading)

## Tech

- Angular 19, TypeScript, Angular Signals
- Server-Side Rendering (@angular/ssr + Express)
- Tailwind CSS
